title: Galaxian^3

ports.device: SindenPS adapter running Sony Dual Analog firmware

requirements: Flash or select the custom Sony Dual Analog firmware.
SindenPS supports 2 Players, to use 4 Players requires two Raspberry Pi's running SindenPS.
Do not use Hyper Blaster / Justifier or Guncon / G-Con45 firmware.
notes: Galaxian 3 does not use a PlayStation lightgun protocol.
SindenPS support works by emulating the Sony Dual Analog controller.
The PlayStation version supports up to four players, but additional multiplayer configuration may be required.

Controls: Trigger fires weapon (PS1 R2). Back-right button adds players on Player Select and pauses gameplay (PS1 Start). Back-left button starts calibration when held for five seconds and cancels when pressed again.

Menu controls: Pump must be held to enable D-pad and lock virtual analog sticks. D-pad navigates menus only while pump is held. Front-left/right buttons act as Select/Back depending on region. When multiple guns are connected, all players must hold pump to prevent virtual stick interference.
Calibration overview: Works best in Widescreen mode with a properly calibrated Sinden and the game window fitting inside the border. Normal mode is letterboxed and may require calibration.
Calibration must be performed in-game when the player's crosshair is visible.
Calibration procedure: Hold back-left button for five seconds to begin. Crosshair moves to center—aim and pull trigger. Then upper-left—aim and pull trigger. Then lower-right—aim and pull trigger.
Calibration result: Firmware calculates center and independent horizontal/vertical scaling.
Calibration persistence: Saved to adapter’s non-volatile memory and survives power-off.
Calibration cancellation: Press back-left again or wait 30 seconds to cancel without overwriting.
